evidence.text: (US$10 million) will support the digital transformation of the higher education and scientific research system.

extra_evidence.text: This will entail expanding the digitalization of all administrative and management processes nationwide, at both central and institutional levels.

It will build on the digitalization effort piloted under the TEEP project and advance the implementation of MOHESR's digital transformation strategy roadmap to digitalize higher education and research administrative systems and platforms.

approaches.name: digital university platforms for virtual mobility, services and AI orientation
approaches.description: Funds virtual labs, distance learning, digitalized admissions, scholarships, assessments and research databases, plus AI labor-market orientation for students. Practices: Virtual labs and distance learning infrastructure for inter-university mobility; Digitalized university service systems: career guidance, simulators, digital assessments, admissions, research proposal/scholarship systems and centralized research database; Digitalized registration, scholarship management and diploma certification systems; Virtual labs and distance learning for inter-university virtual mobility; AI-assisted student orientation system projecting labor market trends.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: remote teaching and virtual mobility across universities - cue: 'pilot' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 2 round(s); context expanded; final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Building on a successful pilot under TEEP that digitalized registration, scholarship management, and diploma certification, it will provide funding for more institutions to acquire equipment and software for virtual labs and distance learning.

extra_evidence.text: Enhanced digital infrastructure will support remote learning, ensure continuity during climate-related disruptions, and facilitate inter- university virtual mobilities, enabling experienced professors from coastal universities to teach students in interior institutions remotely.

Description The list of services might include, but not be limited to: i) students accessing enhanced digital career guidance system; ii) students benefiting from digitally-enabled training such as simulators; iii) students benefiting from innovative ditially enabled assessment methods; iv) students that enroll into courses using newly digitalized admissions systems; iv) students that use newly established or improved digital research proposal or scholarship systems ; vi) university teachers who use the centralized research database.
The list of digitally enabled services will be defined in the MOP.

Building on a successful pilot under TEEP that digitalized registration, scholarship management, and diploma certification, it will provide funding for more institutions to acquire equipment and software for virtual labs and distance learning.

This subcomponent will finance financing information system development, training for both personnel and users of these systems and may include some of the necessary IT equipment (with a priority on energy-efficient and low- emission digital infrastructure).

Enhanced digital infrastructure will also facilitate inter-university virtual mobilities, enabling experienced professors from coastal universities to teach students in interior institutions remotely.

A technical diagnosis of the current system, based on existing studies, carried out in collaboration with BEPP, will be used to review the system ensuring it maximizes employability, is compatible with the future challenges of the knowledge economy and incorporates the use of AI to support student’s decision- making (by, for instance, projecting labor market trends).

category.rationale: Technological: digital infrastructure enables remote delivery

sector.rationale: Funds virtual labs and distance learning infrastructure directly serving higher education delivery.
